title: ISM Services PMI (Nov 2026 data)
source: ISM: the October-data ISM Services report (PRNewswire 302928112, 'Services PMI® at 54.5%; October 2026 ISM® Services PMI® Report', issued 2026-11-04 10:00 ET) names its own successor — "The next ISM® Services PMI® Report featuring November 2026 data will be released at 10:00 a.m. ET on Thursday, December 3" (the fetch tool truncated the quote after "December 3"; the year is the release's own 2026, and 2026-12-03 is a Thursday). Read first-hand on prnewswire.com/news-releases/services-pmi-at-54-5-october-2026-ism-services-pmi-report-302928112.html by this event's own pulse 2026-11-13. Promoted estimate -> confirmed on that line: the dated promotion path this ledger's kill switch #1 named, the same one ism-manufacturing-2026-12-01 took on 2026-11-09. Supersedes the prior EST: third-business-day derivation, which the wire sentence agrees with. ismworld.org's own ROB calendar remains SSO-gated and was not needed. Checked 2026-11-13
notes: Lands 10:00 ET the day BEFORE jobs-2026-12-04 — the last activity read before the payroll that feeds the 12-09 dots, and it carries its own employment index. READ IT, DO NOT TRADE IT: the ism-services-2026-11-04 initial research measured all 8 of 2026's services releases and found release-day moves in TLT/^TNX/SPY/QQQ/XLF/IWM statistically nil, and this event's own research added that the 10:00 ET release HOUR is quieter than an ordinary hour in four of five instruments (hourly bars, n=167 sessions). WHY IT STILL MATTERS, which is the finding its own ledger banked: every federal November-reference price print lands AFTER the 12-09 vote (CPI 12-10, PPI 12-15, import/export 12-17, PCE 12-23), and this is the only 2026 services print inside an FOMC blackout (11-28→12-10) — so ISM mfg Prices Paid 12-01, this print's Prices index, and average hourly earnings on 12-04 are the Committee's entire November-data price picture. Informational, never tradable. Discovered during the jobs-2026-12-04 pulse (2026-09-02) alongside its manufacturing sibling; the earlier attribution of the eight-release measurement to the 09-03 ledger was wrong and is corrected here. PROMOTED estimate -> confirmed 2026-11-13: the 2026-11-04 report names this date (see source); impact stays high on the sequence fact (only tracked ISM Services print inside the 11-28 to 12-10 FOMC blackout).
